disclaimer: IMPORTANT: These 26 cantonal schedules are APPROXIMATIONS derived from a third-party comparative tax-burden index (AccountEX, https://accountex.ch/en/guide/cantonal-tax-comparison), not each canton's official statutory 'simple tax' brackets. They are calibrated to match known combined effective rates at CHF 100,000 and CHF 200,000 (single filer, cantonal capital) and will be less accurate outside that range. multiplier_percent is fixed at 100% for every canton in this phase, meaning the capital-commune's typical multiplier is currently folded into the bracket rates rather than applied separately. Do not use for actual tax filing or relocation decisions without verifying against the relevant canton's official tax administration (Kantonales Steueramt).

states.name: Zug
states.notes: APPROXIMATE. This 3-band schedule is reverse-engineered from a third-party comparative index (combined federal+cantonal+capital-commune effective rates at CHF 100k/200k, 2025/26 period), not Zug's official statutory cantonal brackets. Accuracy is best near CHF 100k-200k and weaker far outside that range. Canton multiplier fixed at 100% for now (Phase 4 will add real commune-level multipliers, which currently make up part of this blended rate). Verify against the official cantonal tax administration before relying on this for real decisions.
